name: TN Adaptive 80
goals: Treat ~40 native FPS as a minimum desired floor rather than a ceiling
Preserve extra native FPS before quality recovery when hardware allows
Reduce microstutter caused by transient camera/streaming spikes
Correct GPU/Mixed/CPU classification with delayed GPU timestamps
Preserve NVIDIA-reported DLSS dynamic-resolution safety bounds
notes: DLSS provider minimum still overrides requested preset minimums.
TN Smooth Motion Blur is intentionally separate and must not be present in this package.
This is a test build and requires in-game validation before being considered stable.
